# Optional local semantic runtime

Transformers.js 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0) and its pinned ONNX Runtime Web dependency run the quantized `Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` model (Apache-2.0). Exact revision, hashes and sizes are in `manifest.json`; license texts are alongside the assets. Model source: https://huggingface.co/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/tree/751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9 . Runtime source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/tree/3.8.1 .

All assets are served from the app's own origin. Enabling semantic ranking downloads and verifies this optional pack; records are processed inside a dedicated browser worker. No hosted inference or Hugging Face API request is used by the application. Mean pooling, normalized 384-dimensional embeddings, q8 quantization and a 256-token truncation limit are explicit. Text beyond the model window is not represented. WebGPU is attempted and WASM is the fallback; numerical results across execution backends need not be bit-identical.

Model files are byte-identical to pinned sources. The generated Transformers bundle has one non-executable provenance header: canonical Sentinel generated-file exclusion, because its virtual relative module names triggered a machine-path false positive. The manifest records both upstream and delivered SHA-256 values; no executable upstream code changed. Keep this transformation explicit. The runtime distribution's source-map comment refers to an unshipped developer map, not an inference dependency. Rebuild/refresh only with reviewed versions and regenerated hashes; do not silently substitute models.
